text:
Ana: Quick proposal — want to prototype calendar-anchored change-windows + a few new deploy-bot flags to reduce rollout friction. Idea: tie a change-window event to a pin/hold and automatic resume/auto-rollback guard.
Mike: Sounds useful. Can you sketch commands?
Ana: Yep, thinking about two parts: 1) UX flags on deploy bot to set a calendar anchor, e.g. `/deploy pin v1.3.2 --hold-until 2024-05-02T15:00Z --calendar-id infra-releases` and 2) small webhook that creates a calendar event and attaches a lifecycle link back to the release.
Priya: Love that. For the bot flags we should have `--grace` (minutes) and `--dry-run` so we can test without holding traffic. Also add an explicit `--rollback-policy` (auto|manual|canary-fallback).
Sam: Example usage would be great.
Ana: Example command mock:
```
/deploy pin v1.3.2 --calendar "release-windows" --hold-until 2024-05-02T15:00Z --grace 10 --rollback-policy canary-fallback --dry-run
```
Ana: And quick webhook curl to create the calendar event (very rough):
```bash
curl -X POST https://calendar.internal/api/events 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CAL_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"title":"Release v1.3.2 window","start":"2024-05-02T14:45:00Z","end":"2024-05-02T15:30:00Z","meta":{"thread":"https://slack.com/archives/eng-releases/p1715123456"}}'
```
Priya: For rollback decisions, can we expose `deploy-bot status` with a one-line decision matrix: latency/counter, error-rate, and recent eval regressions? If auto-rollback triggers, it should post a short decision blob and link to the logs.
Mike: +1. Also add an ephemeral confirm step for org-wide rollbacks so we don't accidentally cascade. Maybe `/deploy rollback now --confirm 2` to require 2 approvers in the channel.
Sam: I'll prototype the calendar webhook and the `--hold-until` behavior this week. Will wire a mock calendar and post a PR to tools.
deploy-bot: Noted — creating a draft task: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-tools/pulls/123 (auto-msg).
Ana: Nice. A couple UX notes: 1) show a small card in the release thread with calendar event and minutes-to-resume, 2) expose a `/deploy resume` and `/deploy extend --mins 30` to adjust on-the-fly, 3) for private deployments respect customer change-windows in the tenant config.
Priya: Also add audit log entries for pin/hold/extend/rollback with who executed and which calendar event ID. Compliance will want that.
Mike: Can we add a `--preview` that generates release notes from the commit range and posts them as a thread summary? Similar to: `/deploy notes generate --commits HEAD~10..HEAD --format short`
Ana: Yup — plan is to wire the notes generator into the same bot so one command orchestration creates event + pins + notes + dry-run.
Sam: I'll open the initial PR with two small pieces: calendar webhook + `--hold-until` flag handling. Will include unit tests and a small CLI shim so folks can experiment locally.
Priya: I'll sketch the rollback decision matrix doc in the repo (template + thresholds) and add an example policy.
Mike: Action items: Sam = PR for webhook/flag, Priya = rollback matrix doc, Ana = UX card mock + examples, I'll review both.
Ana: Cool, thanks team :rocket:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled — pinging this thread in 24h to see prototype status.
